clue.text: In which rail fare may be taken?

definitions.text: In which rail fare may be taken?

parts.words: In which rail fare may be taken?
parts.note: fare here is food, not the ticket price, so the place is a carriage where meals are eaten on a train

explanation.surface: A question about where a train ticket's cost might be paid or collected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fare' tempts you towards tickets; read it as food and the question asks where meals are served on board.
explanation.definitionFit: A restaurant carriage on a train is where passengers sit to eat their meals.

clue.text: Believer in training, not at home

indicators.note: not says the words for being at home are to be left out of the longer word

parts.note: discipline is training that instils obedience or skill
in means at home, as in 'staying in tonight'

explanation.surface: Someone who has faith while still learning, but who is never found at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower who accepts a teacher's doctrine is a believer in it, like the apostles of Jesus.

clue.text: Pinch small drink of spirits

definitions.meaning: to pinch is to squeeze sharply between finger and thumb
a tot or dram of whisky or similar

explanation.surface: Someone nicking a quick shot of liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a sharp squeeze or bite and a small measure of strong liquor.

clue.text: Snare wild ones crossing over at first

indicators.note: crossing means the shuffled letters straddle, so enclose, the single letter
wild suggests the letters of the word ones running out of order
at first takes just the opening letter of the word over

explanation.surface: A trap set for untamed creatures that wander across it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' rearranges ONES into NOSE, and 'crossing' puts the O from 'over at first' inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A loop of rope or wire that tightens is a snare for catching animals.

clue.text: King's wife a prince rather upset

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and disordered, so these three words' letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A queen consort whose royal husband's heir is rather put out.
explanation.walkthrough: The king is Henry VIII; she was the last of his six wives and outlived him.
explanation.definitionFit: She was the sixth and final queen married to Henry VIII of England.

clue.text: Clergyman's house in Crockford's, perhaps DI overlooked?

indicators.note: overlooked means missed out, so these two printed letters are left off the front

parts.note: Crockford's Clerical Directory is the reference book listing Church of England clergy, an example of a directory

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a detective inspector missed a vicar's home listed in the clergy register.
explanation.walkthrough: DI usually means detective inspector; here it is just two letters dropped from DIRECTORY.
explanation.definitionFit: A rector's official residence in an Anglican parish is the rectory.

clue.text: Start of much work for cleaner

indicators.note: start of takes only the opening letter of the word much

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work, especially a musical composition

explanation.surface: A cleaner's day begins with plenty of work.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-handled tool with a head of absorbent strands is used for cleaning floors.

clue.text: Step ahead, fill the bill

parts.note: a measure is a step taken towards an end, as in 'take measures'
up means ahead, as in being one up in a game

explanation.surface: Taking a step forward to show one is good enough for the job.
explanation.definitionFit: To be adequate or meet the required standard is to fill the bill.

clue.text: Fish pasty containing last of haddock

indicators.note: containing means the baked item holds the single letter within it

parts.note: a pasty is a kind of pastry-covered pie

indicators.note: last of takes the final letter of the word haddock

explanation.surface: A fish pie with a bit of haddock inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A long predatory freshwater species is a well-known fish.

clue.text: Drink wine in comfort

parts.note: to sup is to drink, especially in small mouthfuls
port is a fortified wine from Portugal

explanation.surface: Relaxing with a glass of wine in a comfortable chair.
explanation.definitionFit: To give support is to comfort or sustain someone emotionally.

clue.text: Excellent joke

definitions.meaning: ... as an adjective means first-rate, as in a ... shot

explanation.surface: Praise for a very funny gag.
explanation.definitionFit: The word works as an adjective for top-class and a noun for a quip.

clue.text: Question paper — time running out

indicators.note: running out means the letter for time is used up and leaves the word

parts.note: tissue is thin soft paper

explanation.surface: An exam paper with the clock ticking down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Question paper' looks like one phrase, but the definition is just 'Question'.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter under debate, the point in question, is an issue.

clue.text: Youth in cast concealing slip

indicators.note: concealing means the throwing word hides the stumbling word inside it

parts.note: to sling is to cast or throw
to trip is to slip or stumble

explanation.surface: A young actor in a play's cast hiding a mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' looks like a theatre company; here it is the verb, to throw.
explanation.definitionFit: A slender young man still growing is a youth or lad.

clue.text: Book flight

definitions.meaning: the second book of the Old Testament
a mass departure or escape of people

explanation.surface: Reserving a seat on a plane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book' and 'flight' look like reserving a plane seat; both are nouns here.
explanation.definitionFit: It names the Bible book about the Israelites leaving Egypt and any mass departure.

clue.text: Report of alliance funding siege

indicators.note: report of means the words are to be heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: a bloc is an alliance of nations, and aid is funding given to help

explanation.surface: News of money from a coalition paying for a military siege.
explanation.definitionFit: Sealing off a place to stop goods or people getting in or out is a siege tactic.

clue.text: Solver rapidly worked out "senior cabinet minister"

indicators.note: worked out suggests the letters of the two words being solved and rearranged

explanation.surface: The solver quickly cracked a clue whose answer is a top government post.
explanation.walkthrough: The post is a traditional senior office in the UK government, usually held by a cabinet member.
explanation.definitionFit: This ancient office of state is held by a member of the British cabinet.

clue.text: Saw rambler in empty pub

indicators.note: in places the wanderer inside the two remaining letters
empty means the word pub loses its middle, leaving only its outer letters

parts.note: a rover is a wanderer, someone who rambles

explanation.surface: A hiker was spotted in a deserted pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the past of 'see'; it is a noun, an old saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or maxim, the same thing as a short wise adage.

clue.text: Disapprove of old unorthodox popes

indicators.note: unorthodox means not conventional, so the letters of popes are rearranged

explanation.surface: Objecting to heretical pontiffs of the past.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist or be against something is to disapprove of it.

clue.text: Jelly and cream shortly after seeing that

indicators.note: after says the trimmed word comes behind the short word for seeing that

parts.note: as means because or seeing that

indicators.note: shortly means cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: the pick of something is its cream, the best part

explanation.surface: Choosing between jelly and cream for dessert once one has seen it.
explanation.definitionFit: A savoury jelly made from meat stock, used to set or glaze food.

clue.text: Played the part of cadet at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused and all over the place, so the letters of cadet are rearranged

explanation.surface: A naval trainee performed a role while aboard ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To perform a role on stage is to have acted it.

clue.text: Knocks over box

indicators.note: over means turned the other way, so the word for knocks is read backwards

parts.note: raps are sharp knocks

explanation.surface: Someone knocking a crate over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Knocks over' looks like a single phrasal verb; 'over' is the signal to read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To spar is to box, especially in practice rounds.

clue.text: Cost of staple food shown on page

indicators.note: shown on places the food word after the page letter, as one thing set upon another

parts.note: rice is a staple food across much of the world

explanation.surface: A menu page listing what basic foodstuffs cost.
explanation.definitionFit: The amount charged for something is its cost.

clue.text: One feels queen is repelled by insect

parts.note: an ant is an insect

indicators.note: is repelled means driven back, so the queen's name is read backwards

parts.note: Anne was queen of Great Britain from 1702 to 1714

explanation.surface: A monarch is disgusted by a bug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One feels' looks like the start of a sentence; it describes a feeler.
explanation.definitionFit: An insect's feeler is a sensory organ, the thing that feels its surroundings.

clue.text: Sister in cotton uniform

indicators.note: in says the letters are found within the words cotton uniform

explanation.surface: A nurse or sibling wearing a cotton uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a religious order of women is addressed as Sister.

clue.text: Some original equipment

indicators.note: some says only part of the word original is wanted

explanation.surface: Part of the kit is the genuine article.
explanation.definitionFit: A rig is a set of apparatus or gear, as in a drilling rig.

clue.text: Hoedown in a brand new northern church

indicators.note: new suggests the letters of a brand made into something fresh

parts.note: CE stands for Church of England

explanation.surface: A country dance held in a newly built church in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoedown is a lively country dance party, traditionally held in a farm building.
